Amazon Bedrock offers four service tiers for model inference: Reserved, Priority, Standard, and Flex. Reserved automatically overflows to the Standard tier. "service\_tier" : "reserved | priority | default | flex". ResolvedServiceTier shows the actual tier that served your requests.
The response includes `cacheDetails`. The `inputTokens` field represents only the non-cached input tokens. total input tokens = inputTokens + cacheReadInputTokens + cacheWriteInputTokens
CountTokens doesn't incur charges. Token counting is model-specific and will match the token count that would be charged. Mantle uses /anthropic/v1/messages/count_tokens.

Model invocation logging is disabled by default and is only supported for calls made through the `bedrock-runtime` endpoint. Calls through the `bedrock-mantle` endpoint, are not currently captured.

Invocation logs only provide per-request detail. The finest grain is per usage type per day; they do not produce a per-request row.

Input tokens, Output tokens, Cache read tokens, and Cache write tokens are separate. Both reports aggregate Amazon Bedrock cost by usage type over an hour or a day; neither carries a per-`requestId` identifier.
The Price List Query API and Price List Bulk API provide pricing details for informational purposes only. AWS charges the prices on the *service pricing page*.
The service index includes "currentVersionUrl", the URL for the most up-to-date service price list file.
It can take up to 24 hours for data to appear and data is refreshed at least once every 24 hours.
